doc: Vitamin D supplementation for term breastfed infants to prevent vitamin D deficiency and improve bone health

entries.claim: 母乳喂养婴儿每日补充400 IU维生素D（至少6个月）可提高血清25-OH维生素D水平并降低维生素D不足（25-OH维生素D < 50 nmol/L）的发生率。
entries.source_doc: Vitamin D supplementation for term breastfed infants to prevent vitamin D deficiency and improve bone health

entries.claim: 对于维生素D缺乏高风险的母乳喂养婴儿，母亲补充维生素D可降低婴儿维生素D不足和维生素D缺乏的风险。
entries.source_doc: Vitamin D supplementation for term breastfed infants to prevent vitamin D deficiency and improve bone health

entries.claim: 在维生素D缺乏高风险人群中，给母乳喂养婴儿直接补充维生素D（400 IU/天）比给哺乳期母亲补充维生素D更能提高婴儿维生素D水平并降低维生素D不足和缺乏的发生率。
entries.source_doc: Vitamin D supplementation for term breastfed infants to prevent vitamin D deficiency and improve bone health

entries.claim: 哺乳期母亲每日补充维生素D ≥4000 IU可使母乳喂养婴儿的维生素D水平与婴儿每日补充400 IU达到相似水平。
entries.source_doc: Vitamin D supplementation for term breastfed infants to prevent vitamin D deficiency and improve bone health
